Message:
[PATCH] hugetlbpage: return VM_FAULT_OOM on oom

Remove wrong and misleading comments.

Return VM_FAULT_OOM if the hugetlbpage fault handler cannot allocate a
page.  do_no_page will end up doing do_exit(SIGKILL).
